title: Great, but just a couple  things to mention
body:
Amazing app, really and such cute designs. The AI FAQ can sometimes be really annoying, especially when you're asking a question like 'can you do this?' and it just doesn't answer you if the feature doesn't exist. Another great thing you could add is parental controls. I think it would be really convenient if my parents could, like, set goals for me without having to make their own account if they don't need it.

I came into this app thinking it would be more like a tamagotchi, but it's basically a digital to-do list app that has a cute little birb of your own to look at. Of course, I wouldn't want you to add the feature where my birb could DIE cuz that would just be depressing. I just think that adding something like a feeding feature in a similar way to the petting feature would make the experience feel a bit more like a TAMAGOTCHI. Also, make it more clear about the rules for the travel thing because I wanted to finish finchie forest before I went somewhere else and I didn't know I couldn't go backkkk :(

I hope you at least consider these ideas because I bet it would be beneficial for a lot of people. Thanks

author: Me to the power of Pi

title: Positive/negative coding of reflections needs improvement
body:
Overall I do love this app and would love to give it a higher rating, but when it asks you to reflect on something it doesn’t rank things correctly. For example if the prompt is what stressed you out today, and you respond with something the app considers “good”? Then it will count your negative experience as a positive, and vice versa. If the question is what did you enjoy today then any answer you give should be counted as a positive. I get that it’s more difficult for reflections that aren’t so black and white, but in these cases it should be clear.

Anyway, the point is I regret the time I included Donald Trump in a list of things that were stressing me out. Now I get these messages being like here’s some things that lifted you up this week :) But Donald Trump is on there… I tried deleting the reflection and blocking the tag but his ghost still haunts me.

title: Don’t get this app if you get VERY attached to little things
body:
I’d just like to preface by saying that I did absolutely love this app. There were so many things that were super helpful and I loved talking to my bird at the end of every day. I had this app for 2 years and used it every single day but one morning I went to open the app and it said “looks like your pet data got corrupted” and offered to have me rehatch a new pet. After a lot of…I’ll admit…crying to my parents I rehatched the pet. Have her the same name and gender and started again. She doesn’t have the same personality and I’ve had to start my locations again as she had never been to any (despite the fact that my first finch had been to 7) and start again. 
I lost my streak, by now I would have over 700 days as I have still not missed a day. I’m not going to lie, I’m still pretty upset about it. 
The team was super nice when I emailed them but there was nothing that could be done. 

I just felt as though I needed to warn people because for a few weeks after this happened it actually devastated me to open the app 😂. I had also recently suffered some loss (outside of a pixelated bird) and I think those two things together really made me upset. So I just wanted people to know that if you get super super attached to things and get very upset when they are gone then maybe this app might not be the best gamble. 
It’s still a great app with great features and an amazing team but it might be a risk to download. 

:)

title: Love my lil self-care buddy!
body: So I usually don’t keep up with self-care apps for more than a week or so, and I NEVER leave app reviews, so… I guess this silly little app has made me make an exception to both of those rules! I love this app. I struggle with anxiety, depression, OCD and PTSD, which often makes basic self-care things like brushing my teeth or going outside almost impossible, but this app is exactly the motivation I need to get those things done! I love making my little bird happy by doing things to promote my own well-being, but I also love that on the days when I really really can’t do those little things, there isn’t any judgment or sense of failure. For now I only have the free version, which is amazing enough by itself, but when I can afford it I might splurge and get finch plus. I also never usually spend money on apps, so… I hope that tells you something about how much I love it! I especially love the ‘journeys’ feature, like guided goals to combat anxiety, get a good eating routine etc. They’ve been SO helpful for me, because sometimes when you’re in a low place, you just don’t know how to climb back up, but this app has some really helpful (and achievable!) suggestions on how to start, and once you’ve started it’s so much easier to keep going, one tiny step at a time❤️

body: I’ve only had this for a couple days. i felt absolutely miserable with myself and life in general and was struggling to do basic tasks. then i saw a tiktok that was like “apps you should download” so i downloaded finch. and i feel so refreshed and it may sound silly but i also feel supported by my little feathery friend.
